objects.name: Attack Flow
objects.description: Extends STIX 2.1 with features to create Attack Flows.

objects.name: Detection technique coverage: o365-email-send-attachments-excessive-volume
objects.description: The following analytic identifies when an O365 email account sends an excessive number of email attachments to external recipients within a short period (within 1 hour). This behavior may indicate a compromised account where the threat actor is attempting to exfiltrate data from the mailbox. Threat actors may attempt to transfer data through email as a simple means of exfiltration from the compromised mailbox.
